text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm returning from looking at sports
equipment
with Eishin Flash when...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... I know that sweet and buttery
scent from
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Could it be coming from that shop? That
German
bakery looks new.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Why, those are Schneeballen! They look
fresh out
of the oven and absolutely
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They're a famous deep-fried pastry from

Germany. They're sweet and crispy and
come with
a variety of toppings.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Look, they even have some covered in
roasted
soybean flour—a truly Japanese
topping.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Soy isn't as sweet as chocolate or
powdered
sugar, so I imagine it gives the
pastry a rich,
earthy aroma.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem. That said, it is almost
dinnertime, so I
should refrain from
indulging on pastries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Snacking now would upset my daily
caloric
balance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Snacking now would upset my daily
caloric
balance.
choice_data_list: 歩き回った分たくさん食べよう！
choice_data_list_en: Want to split one in half?
Want to split one in half?
Let's eat a ton to make up for all that walking!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sharing one?! ...That's a wonderful idea.
choice_data_list: 歩き回った分たくさん食べよう！
choice_data_list_en: Want to split one in half?
Want to split one in half?
Let's eat a ton to make up for all that walking!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll go buy us a soy Schneeball right
away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It was as delicious as the toasted
scent made
it seem. That was
scrumptious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It had a softer, fluffier texture than the

Schneeball my parents sell at their shop.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The dough wasn't as sweet as the type in

Germany either, and it appears they
used a
different kind of frying oil too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we shared one. I was able to
fully enjoy
the treat without worrying
about excess calories.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There isn't? But if I overindulge...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then again, we walked so much today
that we did
use up more energy than
usual...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It may be necessary to compensate for
that
deficit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I believe I shall take your advice and replenish my lost energy reserves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash zips into the shop and eats
as many
Schneeballen as she can until
she can't take
another bite.
